messages:
Maya (Marketing): hey all — I put a fresh pass of the product launch blog in the doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1defLIVE. Need quick checks on benchmark phrasing, hero claim, and webinar registration flow.
Tom (Product): skimming. the hero currently reads "35% lower inference spend". is that an avg or a best-case? we should be explicit.
Maya (Marketing): original came from the Optimize cost-profile experiment across retrieval workloads. maybe "up to 35% lower inference spend for retriever-heavy apps"?
Elena (Legal): "up to" is fine. please add the eval anchor in the appendix and a short methodology line. also remove the named customer quote until the contract signature is confirmed.
Sam (Growth): webinar CTA — prefer we capture intent on the sign-up: option for "Try now (self-serve)" vs "Talk to sales" so routing is automatic. I can map HubSpot properties accordingly.
Noor (Design): hero art uploaded (Figma link in doc). Suggest two CTA styles for the AB test: primary button text = "Register: Hands-on demo" and alt = "Save my seat". also added OG preview image variants.
Maya (Marketing): thanks. Sam — can you paste the HubSpot mapping and UTM pattern? want dev to add to blog template.
Sam (Growth): mapping: hubspot_field:lead_source = blog_post, hubspot_field:lead_subsource = webinar_cta, hubspot_field:intent_bucket = {self_serve|sales}. UTM example: ```?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_q2&utm_term=heroA```
forms-bot: created form (id: hb-20240612-02) and webhook at /hooks/hubspot/webhook-hb-20240612-02. test event sent.
Tom (Product): small note on latency claim in the subhead — current text "p95 < 200ms on short context gen" is misleading without config. suggest: "p95 ≈ 200ms on short-context experiments (Dedicated config A, seq=128)".
Elena (Legal): I'll do a quick-pass in the doc tonight. flagging privacy line for the webinar form: we need the minimal data notice and opt-in checkbox text.
Maya (Marketing): added draft checkbox copy: "I agree to receive product updates and webinar info from Redwood Inference". Elena, tweak if needed.
Noor (Design): QA: social preview card has alt text and a shortened headline for mobile.
Sam (Growth): also recommend adding a hidden UTM variant for the AB test: content=variantA or variantB so we can tie conversions to hero copy.
Maya (Marketing): good call — I'll add content=heroA for the primary.
Tom (Product): I'll drop the benchmark appendix snippet into the doc with a one-paragraph method and link to the raw run logs.
Elena (Legal): reviewed. removed customer name, tightened the claim language, and added the privacy checkbox language: "By registering you consent to communications; see our privacy policy."
Sam (Growth): HubSpot mapping complete and posted in the doc (form id hb-20240612-02). webhook verified. I'll create the Salesforce campaign: "2024-Q2 Dedicated Launch" and share campaign id shortly.
forms-bot: webhook delivered sample_event_1 to /integrations/hubspot/ingest — status 200.
Maya (Marketing): next steps recap: 1) Tom finalize bench appendix + run link, 2) Elena finalize legal copy (done), 3) Sam wire campaign & SFDC mapping (in progress), 4) Noor lock hero assets (done). Aim to publish Wednesday EOD. Drop final ack here when you
re green. :rocket:
Tom (Product): ack — bench appendix added.
Sam (Growth): almost done, posting SFDC campaign id in 10m.
Noor (Design): hero locked and exported; OGs uploaded.
Maya (Marketing): perfect — leaving thread for final publish ack. :eyes:
